description: Approve, reject or rewrite one pending memory, only as the owner decides. Needs the owner's review pending memories permission.

decision.description: approve keeps it, reject discards it, update replaces its text and keeps it pending.

expected_content_revision.description: The content_revision listed with it, so a changed memory is not overwritten.

text.description: Only with update: the rewritten memory.

name: review_pending_memory
